confidence_notes: Holistic estimates for Ubud and Canggu in July, when tourist demand is strong. Local meals and coffee are more predictable than lodging prices, which vary widely by location and season. Cocktail and wine estimates use their typical price premium over local draft beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Bali's tourist-oriented Ubud and Canggu, with local warung prices for inexpensive meals and higher tourist-area prices for drinks and accommodation.
